gloss: to exert power; to wield influence; to show its force

definitions.gloss: to exert power; to wield influence; to show its force
definitions.explanation: To demonstrate or exercise great power, strength, or effectiveness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{威力|いりょく}を{振|ふ}るった。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧な⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{威力|いりょく}を{振|ふ}るう。
examples.english: This new detergent is effective even against stubborn stains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{威力|いりょく}を{振|ふ}るい、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: He wielded his power within the team and changed the flow of the game.

notes:
⟦{威力|いりょく}→威力：19611_iryoku⟧ means power, might, or force. ⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ means to wield, brandish, or demonstrate. Together they express the idea of power being actively exercised or demonstrated. Can be used for natural forces (typhoons, earthquakes), tools and products (showing effectiveness), or people (wielding authority).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{威力|いりょく}→威力：19611_iryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate power (similar meaning, slightly more formal)
- ⟦{威力|いりょく}→威力：19611_iryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have power/force
- ⟦すさまじい→すさまじい：07674_susamajii⟧⟦{威力|いりょく}→威力：19611_iryoku⟧: tremendous force

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧: to exercise power — more general
- ⟦{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう→腕を振るう：07452_udewofuruu⟧: to show one's skill — emphasizes demonstrating ability
- ⟦{猛威|もうい}を{振|ふ}るう→猛威を振るう：17817_mouiwofuruu⟧: to rage, to wreak havoc — stronger and more destructive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{猛威|もうい}を{振|ふ}るう→猛威を振るう：17817_mouiwofuruu⟧: to rage, to run rampant — implies destructive, overwhelming force (diseases, storms)
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう→権力を振るう：23231_kenryokuwofuruu⟧: to wield authority — specifically about political or institutional power
